workflow: limit open PRs, and settle and close issues

Adds rules to docs/workflow.md §6 so that work moves through issues and
pull requests without being left open and forgotten:

- picking a task: only a ready issue (triaged, not owner-decision, not an
  option unless the owner asks, blockers closed), claimed with a comment,
  and released with a comment if work stops;
- at most two active pull requests per author; Dependabot's and parked
  ones do not count, and the limit never blocks finishing work;
- parking only with a Blocker: and a Recheck: line;
- no silent abandonment: after 14 days without the author's activity, the
  author is asked and has seven days before the pull request is parked or
  closed;
- settling: Closes #N or Part of #N, a closing-keyword check before every
  merge, every mentioned issue checked after it, and closing a pull request
  unmerged never closes its task;
- cleanup after merge, and a queue review every 30 days.

CONTRIBUTING.md asks contributors to claim an issue before starting.

Reviewed by GLM in two rounds (docs/reviews/2026-11-19-workflow-pr-limits.md):
both passed; the eight minor findings were fixed.

Closes #4
